name: Florida Division of Elections

feed.identity_note: Answered our named User-Agent on Nov 3, 10:18 PM CT (200). A read without a ?v= key got Azure Front Door's Nov 2 copy (all zeros, TCP_HIT); with the key the office's Downloads page uses, a fresh copy (TCP_MISS, Last-Modified Wed, 04 Nov 2026 04:18:03 GMT).
feed.election_id_from: The file's own ElectionDate column (every row 11/03/2026) and the file name the office's Downloads page links (https://floridaelectionwatch.gov/Downloads, "2026 General Election, November 3, 2026, Unofficial Election Night Results"). The file carries no election name or id.

complete_marker_note: None: the state file has no complete flag, and the count runs past election night (cure deadline 5 PM Nov 5, unofficial returns due noon Nov 7, overseas ballots through Nov 13), so Florida reads counting until official.
